blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Adjectives give colour and clarity to your sentences. In English, the adjective comes before the noun. We say a blue folder, a big office, and a red pen. It is a simple rule, but it helps a lot.

Today we describe the office. We use easy colour words and size words. A black laptop is on the desk. The folder is blue. The paper is white. It is a big office and a good place to work.

Today you learn five useful words and you practise a lot. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: In English, where does the adjective go?
options: At the end of the sentence
items.why: "the adjective comes before the noun" — a blue folder, a big office.

items.q: What colour is the folder?
items.why: "The folder is blue."

items.q: What is on the desk?
items.why: "A black laptop is on the desk."

items.q: The text says the office is "a good place to work". This suggests that…
options: the writer feels positive about the office
the writer does not like the office
items.why: Inferência: "a good place to work" mostra uma opinião positiva sobre o escritório.

items.q: The writer says "Take your time. Every sentence counts." The writer would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: You should finish as fast as possible and not think.
items.why: Inferência: "take your time" e "every sentence counts" pedem calma e cuidado, o oposto de correr sem pensar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James no escritório da Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello. My name is James. Welcome to my office. It is a big office and it is very quiet today.

Look at my desk. I have a black laptop and a blue folder. My pen is red. The paper is white. I like colours. They help me stay organised.

I have a small bag under the desk. It is black too. Next to me there is a new chair. It is comfortable and I am happy with it.

Today we have a long meeting at two o'clock. I have a good idea for the team. First, I take my time. I write my notes. Then I speak slowly and clearly.

Practice is simple. Look at one object. Say the colour and the size. A big office. A red pen. A blue folder. Try it now. Take your time. Every word counts.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What colour is James's folder?
items.why: "I have a black laptop and a blue folder."

items.q: What is under the desk?
items.why: "I have a small bag under the desk."

items.q: When is the meeting today?
items.why: "Today we have a long meeting at two o'clock."

items.q: James says he likes colours because they help him stay organised. This suggests that…
options: James finds colours useful at work
items.why: Inferência: para ele as cores têm uma função prática — o ajudam a se organizar.

items.q: How would you best describe James's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele fala devagar, dá boas-vindas e diz "take your time" — um tom calmo e acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The sky is blue today." Blue means…
items.why: Blue = azul.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Stop! The light is ___."
items.why: Red = vermelho — a cor do sinal de "pare".

items.q: "My new laptop is black." Black means…
items.why: Black = preto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The paper is clean and ___."
items.why: White = branco — a cor comum do papel limpo.

items.q: "We work in a big office." Big means…
items.why: Big = grande (o oposto de small).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please write down your name and the colour of the folder." To write down means to…
items.why: Write down = anotar, colocar no papel.

items.q: "The teacher will hand out the blue folders." To hand out means to…
items.why: Hand out = distribuir, entregar para as pessoas.

items.q: "Please fill in your name on the white paper." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher com a informação.

items.q: "We set up the big room for the meeting." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar, organizar o espaço.

items.q: "Everyone can take part in the meeting." To take part means to…
items.why: Take part = participar, tomar parte.
